name: sportos
description: Chat with your retained SportOS training history using authenticated read-only athlete tools.

interface.longDescription: Read your retained running, cycling and swimming history, training volume, personal bests and activity metrics from your own SportOS account. Requires SportOS sign-in and explicit approval. Does not change data or fetch providers.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my recent training with coverage caveats.
Show my retained running personal bests.
Compare my weekly training volume using SportOS evidence.
